assumptions.assumption: The public internet zone is a network boundary.
assumptions.basis: The zone is labelled "Trust zone: public internet" and no different controlling party or authority level is stated.

assumptions.assumption: The internal network zone is a network boundary.
assumptions.basis: The zone is labelled "Trust zone: internal network" and no different controlling party or authority level is stated.

assumptions.assumption: The payroll team environment is a network boundary.
assumptions.basis: The zone is labelled "Trust zone: payroll team environment"; no different controlling party or authority level is stated.

assumptions.assumption: The rota database contains business-critical operating records.
assumptions.basis: The store is named "rota database", and rotas are operating records.

assumptions.assumption: The file share contains financial data.
assumptions.basis: The flow into the store is labelled "write payroll export"; payroll data is financial.

assumptions.assumption: The file share's data is confidential.
assumptions.basis: The file share contains a payroll export, which is financial data.

assumptions.assumption: The colleague-to-application flow carries business-critical shift records.
assumptions.basis: The flow is labelled "view shifts"; shifts are operating records.

assumptions.assumption: The store-manager-to-application flow carries business-critical rota records.
assumptions.basis: The flow is labelled "build rota"; rotas are operating records.

assumptions.assumption: The rota request flow carries business-critical rota data.
assumptions.basis: The flow is labelled "rota requests"; rota data is an operating record.

assumptions.assumption: The scheduling service holds or transforms business-critical rota records.
assumptions.basis: The service reads and writes rotas through the flow labelled "read write rotas".

assumptions.assumption: The scheduling service holds or transforms financial payroll data.
assumptions.basis: The service writes a payroll export through the flow labelled "write payroll export".

assumptions.assumption: The scheduling web app holds or transforms business-critical rota data.
assumptions.basis: The app receives a request labelled "build rota" and sends "rota requests".

assumptions.assumption: The scheduling-service-to-database flow carries business-critical rota records.
assumptions.basis: The flow is labelled "read write rotas"; rotas are operating records.

assumptions.assumption: The scheduling-service-to-file-share flow carries financial data.
assumptions.basis: The flow is labelled "write payroll export"; payroll data is financial.

assumptions.assumption: The payroll-system-to-file-share flow carries financial data.
assumptions.basis: The flow is labelled "collect payroll export"; payroll data is financial.

assumptions.assumption: The store manager is a source of business-critical rota records.
assumptions.basis: The store manager initiates the flow labelled "build rota".
